review_conclusions: Read order and finite per-read caps match contract. Census membership is validated before any callback; callback receives only validated selected PID and fixed filenames. Exact bytes validation prevents mutable or subclass callback payloads and rejects overcap results. Trusted callback must still enforce bounded actual I/O.

Both stat and cgroup are sampled twice. PID/start/PPID stability plus status PID/PPID cross-check reject observed reuse/reparenting/membership drift. Missing namespace and memory remain None, raw binary cmdline retained, parent start remains unknown and no invocation attribution is inferred.

Reader exceptions are not caught/replaced; tests verify original object identity, falsey OSError, interruption, and stop-at-failure behavior. Parsing errors remain typed ObservationError without success-shaped fallback.

Clock arithmetic rejects bool and non-int inputs deliberately with exact type checks, rejects reversed/out-of-u64 values, preserves integer precision above2**53, widens intervals outward and selects the next strictly future100ms grid slot without catchup. Overflow is explicit.

New public functions and internal reader have annotations. Dict[str,object] is broad but truthful for the heterogeneous diagnostic record; no new unchecked Any or mutable default. Test helpers are unannotated consistently with existing unittest fixtures; no blocking type or correctness issue found.
limitations: Partial step4 helpers only. No actual path confinement, target epoch/boot/cgroup-inode validation, topology enforcement, clock-domain acquisition, scheduler loop, namespace/root join, parent-chain observation, schema serialization, marker/ACK validation or live observer is established.

Double samples detect observed inconsistency; they cannot exclude unobserved ABA/exec changes or prove an atomic snapshot. One NSpid sample is retained, not continuous namespace stability. No parent or unrelated process is read to fill ancestry.

Callback is trusted for finite underlying reads and owned path. Post-return size checks cannot bound a malicious callback allocation or blocking duration. Request target bytes are exact comparison data, not normalized filesystem authorization.

No formal coverage metric or guest Python3.12 execution claimed. No runtime memory/overhead/storage qualification, proof acceptance, resource epoch change, old max6325 waiver, native/SDK run, or product acceptance.
Review binds only listed frozen source hashes; later docs and any source changes require parent final delivery validation.
